project.title: Prairie strip removal of swine manure associated bacteria from runoff
project.description: Simulated rainfall events were used to create artificial runoff on field plots with swine manure amendment and prairie strips as treatment factors. Manure associated rbacteria were characterized in runoff samples collected during the rainfall simulation and in soil samples collected over 153 days after the rainfall simulation. Samples include manure, runoff water, runoff sediment, and soil.
